text: Illustration. A different car, April 20th account
In April, an empty Waymo was swept into Salado Creek.
observed: Option a 16.0 to 16.8 s. Same second overhead framing. The large rotated white car, bare seats in pale roof glass, rides left past the pale ledge and oak crown with soft scalloped foam at its rear, a dark shadow offset beneath it and thin branching wake strands at 16.0 to 16.2. It leaves the left edge progressively and by 16.8 only foam and a sliver remain. Thick stripes stay edge to edge. A thin short pale line at the ledge edge (16.2 to 16.4) and a small curved mark near the right end of the upper stripe (16.6) are visible. Crown stays below the chip; car stays above caption.
